GOVERNMENT OF STATE
PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT (PWD)
OFFICE OF THE SUPERINTENDING ENGINEER, STATE HIGHWAY DIVISION

CORRIGENDUM & EXTENSION NOTICE NO. 01
Corrigendum Ref: PWD/SH/2026/TND-441/CORR-01
Date: 18 October 2026

SUBJECT: Amendment and Timeline Extension for Tender NIT Ref: PWD/SH/2026/TND-441 (SH-12 Widening)

Following queries raised during the Pre-Bid conference on 10 October 2026 and subsequent administrative review, the competent authority approves the following modifications:

1. REVISED TIMELINE & DEADLINE EXTENSION:
- Bid Submission Deadline: EXTENDED from 25 October 2026 to 15 November 2026 up to 15:00 IST (+21 days extension).
- Technical Bid Opening Date: RE-SCHEDULED to 16 November 2026 at 11:00 IST.

2. RELIEF & FEE CONCESSIONS FOR MSMEs & STARTUPS:
- Tender Document Fee: Completely WAIVED (INR NIL) for certified MSMEs and DPIIT-recognized Startups (Originally INR 10,000).
- Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Concessional EMD of INR 1,50,000 applicable for registered MSMEs (Reduced by INR 50,000 from original INR 2,00,000).

3. AMENDED PREQUALIFICATION TURNOVER:
- The required average annual financial turnover for local state domiciled Class-1 contractors is REDUCED to INR 3,00,00,000 (Three Crores Only) from previous INR 5,00,00,000.

4. OTHER CLAUSES:
All other terms, conditions, specifications, and performance bank guarantee covenants specified in original NIT PWD/SH/2026/TND-441 remain unaltered.

Superintending Engineer, PWD State Highway Division
Email: se-shd@pwd.state.gov.in
